data: Which of the following has the highest source contribution at target token position 20?

The question asks which model has the highest source contribution at target token position 20. From the caption, we know that Figure 5 shows results for random prefixes, and subfigure (a) represents the contribution of source. The models compared are baseline, wd_source, wd_target, and MRT. 

Looking at subfigure (a), we can see that the line representing the MRT model is consistently above the other lines throughout the range of target token positions. At target token position 20, the MRT line is the highest among all the models shown. Therefore, the MRT model has the highest source contribution at target token position 20.
